event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Singapore Straits Indonesia 01° 06.67' N 103° 44.95' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report May 2024
sources.text: Three robbers armed with a rod boarded a ship underway. Duty crew noticed the robbers entering the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the robbers escaped empty handed.
